title: Abbas Kya Kare
body:
haye abbas kya kare
roka hua hai taygh ko ghazi hai tashnakaam
hukm e imam e waqt se majboor hai ghulam
armaan saara jang ka ashkon mein beh gaya
abbas aaj laashe uthaane ko reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
milti nahi hai ran ki riza jab imam se
abbas kya kare
laashon pe laashe aate rahe dekhta rahe
abbas kya kare
<<DIVIDER>>
koi baccha maqtal se jab
khoon mein naha kar aata hai
aaqa laasha laate hai to
sharm se sar jhuk jaata hai
tukde huwe hai khaak pe wo godh ke pale
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ijazat milti nahi
aaj bahot sharminda hoo
aun o mohamed jaan se guzre
aur mai ab tak zinda hoo
binte ali ke lakhte jigar dono mar gaye
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein kya haal hua hai
aaqa hassan ke bete ka
dil mein mere zakhm bana hai
qasim ke har tukde ka
ghatri bana ke laayi gayi mere saamne
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tadbeer ye maqtal ki hai
mashk mai le kar jaunga
bibi sakina ki khaatir mai
pani le kar aaunga
maangi hai is ne izne wigha haath jod ke
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya saamne behta hai bas
izn wigha ka mil jaaye
saaqi e kausar ke bacchon par
pani bandh hua haye
rote huwe ye aas se hai mujhko dekhte
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwahish ye hai aakhri lamha
unki ziyarat hum paayein
aisa nahi ho laash utha kar
mere aaqa thak jaaye
aaye madad ko aaqa mere kis tarha kahe
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman pani lene gaye
abbas ki mushkil kam na hui
teer qamar aankhon mein laga tha
khoon baha aur mashk chidi
sar pe laga hai gurz mere haath kat gaye
abbas kya kare...
author: Qamar Hasnain
